real_fields.runway_length_m,runway_surface: OurAirports runways.csv (public domain); CYGZ and CYLC length and CYXN/CYCS surface from Wikipedia infoboxes citing the Canada Flight Supplement (secondary source, flagged in data_flags)

synthetic_fields.is_medical_hub,is_cargo_hub,is_passenger: project assumption informed by public knowledge; not an official designation
synthetic_fields.base_weather_risk,base_wildfire_risk: constant placeholders used by the transparent risk score
synthetic_fields.community_name: current official community names substituted for legacy names in sources (Kinngait, Sanirajak, Naujaat, Resolute)

disclaimer: NORTHSTAR AI is a research simulation. Synthetic fields are not real Canadian aviation operations data.
